research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: ArchForm is researching design and manufacture of orthodontic appliances using a user interface that displays models of teeth and palates to define non-moveable zones, enabling precise design of dental appliances. Work on fabrication of dental appliances via rapid prototyping forms aligners from olefin polymers without intermediary molds. They also develop unibody orthodontic appliances and appliances to cause intrusion of posterior teeth. Overall, they focus on digital design, direct fabrication, and functional clear aligner systems.

product.name: Treatment Planning Software
product.description: Software for orthodontic treatment planning that converts scanned dental models into treatment setups with automated trimming, segmentation, and alignment.

product.name: In-Office Aligner Manufacturing
product.description: Enables dental practices to 3D print models and thermoform aligners on-site for immediate patient treatment starts.

product.name: Direct Print Aligners
product.description: Technology to 3D print clear aligners directly using MemoryForm™ shape memory material.

product.name: Factory-Made Aligners
product.description: Clear aligners manufactured and shipped from ArchForm’s robotic factory, with optional custom branding for dental offices.

product.name: Indirect Bonding
product.description: A digital solution for precise bracket placement using indirect bonding techniques.

product.name: ArchMill Trimming Robot
product.description: Automated robotic system for trimming dental models and appliances in orthodontic workflows.
